newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Seafront reduces stake in Inchrome.
newsitem.headline: Seafront reduces stake in Inchrome.

text.p: Oil explorer Seafront Resources Corp said on Tuesday that it had sold 84,085,896 shares of Integrated Chrome Corp (Inchrome) at 70 centavos each in a block sale.
"The sale would effectively reduce the corporation's holdings in Inchrome to slightly more than 5.0 percent," the company told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
Seafront officials were not available to comment on the sale.

Mining firm Inchrome, which is currently trading at 1.02 pesos per share, on Monday said it planned to convert itself into a real estate company. Inchrome's major shareholders are the Araneta family who have large land holdings.
